Help

What are extra hours, and how do they work?

Extra hours are one-time purchases of 5 or 15 hours for Pro and MAX subscribers. They never expire, they are used after your plan hours run out, and they stay yours even if your subscription ends.

Free to download, with 60 minutes of transcription every month.

Last updated: November 16, 2026

How do extra hours work?

  • An extra-hours pack is a one-time purchase, not a subscription. It doesn’t renew.
  • Packs are sold to active Pro and MAX subscribers, in 5 or 15 hours.
  • Extra hours are used only after your plan hours for the current period are used up. They don’t reset.
  • They never expire, and they stay usable after your subscription ends, including on the free plan once your free minutes are used.
  • Your balance is shown in Settings. After a purchase, it can take a few minutes to appear, and recordings waiting for hours start by themselves.

What happens on a new phone or after reinstalling?

  • Your extra hours are kept on Verbi’s server, linked to your purchase, not stored on the phone.
  • While your subscription is active, sign in to the same Apple ID or Google account on the new phone and tap Restore purchases in Settings → Subscription; your remaining extra hours move with it, which can take a few minutes.
  • If your subscription has ended, we cannot promise yet that extra hours follow you to a new phone.
  • Plan hours you already used in the current period stay with that period; only the extra-hours balance moves.

Can I get a refund?

  • Apple or Google handles refunds, not Verbi. Ask in the App Store or Google Play where you bought the pack.
  • If a store refunds an extra-hours pack, those hours are removed from your balance. If you have already used some of them, your balance goes down to zero; it never goes below zero.

What happens to extra hours if I delete my data?

If you ask us to delete your data, the usage counter and any extra hours you have left are deleted with it, and they can’t be restored. Your purchase stays with Apple or Google. Deleting the app on its own doesn’t delete them. See where your data is stored.

Frequently asked questions

Do extra hours expire?

No. They never expire and they don’t reset.

Can I buy extra hours without a subscription?

Packs are sold to active Pro and MAX subscribers. Hours you already bought stay usable after the subscription ends.

My extra hours haven’t arrived. What now?

Wait a few minutes and open Verbi again; the balance refreshes when the app comes to the front. If it still hasn’t appeared, write to theverbiapp@gmail.com. If a purchase fails, the “Contact Us” button on its message opens a ready-made email.
